messages:
Noah Rivera: hey team, accepted the org invite but I can only see public repos. trying to open infra/infra-rt gives 404. also when I tried to enable passkey 2FA on my iPhone it failed with 'policy blocked'. who do I bug?

onboarding-bot: welcome Noah! :wave: Typical causes: invite sent to a different email, account classified as an outside collaborator, or SSO/2FA pending. See onboarding checklist: https://docs.redwood.example/devex/github-access. If you want, @DevEx-Kim can triage.

DevEx-Kim: @Noah Rivera can you share your GitHub handle? I can check org membership and team ACLs quickly.

Noah Rivera: handle is noahr

DevEx-Kim: looks like you accepted but your membership type is "outside collaborator" instead of "member" 1 This often happens when invites are originally sent to a personal repo invite. Ops needs to convert you to a full member and SSO authorize. Also see sso_required flag.

Noah Rivera: how can I check sso_required?

Jordan: you can run this locally if you have gh installed:
```
gh api /orgs/redwood-inference/memberships/noahr
```
If you see "role": "outside" or "sso_required": true that's the issue.

Noah Rivera: ran it, shows "role": "outside" and "sso_required": false. so SSO not the blocker.

Ops-Alex: thanks for the details. I converted your account to "member" and re-added you to team eng-runtime with write access. Give it 30s and then try again.

Noah Rivera: still getting 404 on infra-rt repo.

IT-Lauren: 404 after role change can be cached tokens. Steps: 1) logout of github.com, 2) clear cookies or open incognito, 3) log back in. If using gh, run `gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh`.

Noah Rivera: did incognito and re-login, now repo page loads. thanks!

Noah Rivera: quick follow-up: passkey 2FA still fails with "policy blocked" when I try to add it on iPhone 12. I can add TOTP but wanted passkey.

IT-Lauren: corporate policy currently allows passkeys only on managed devices; personal devices are blocked by IdP. Options: enroll TOTP and request a security key (YubiKey) from IT, or register the device with Device Management. If you want a YubiKey, file IT ticket RW-901.

Noah Rivera: filed RW-901. also, any tips for cloning with credential helper issues? after the role change my saved credentials still 403 during push.

DevEx-Kim: if you're on macOS, run `git credential-osxkeychain erase` (or use credential manager on Windows) then try `git clone`/`git push` and re-enter creds or use `gh auth login` to set up credentials. That usually clears the stale cache.

Noah Rivera: ran the erase command, push succeeded. all set. thanks everyone and happy to be here! :tada:

Ops-Alex: welcome aboard Noah. Logged a short note in onboarding tracker about outside-collab edge-case so People Ops can prevent it.

Noah Rivera: awesome, appreciate it :)
